operating_rules: CURRENT contains exactly one product train.
NEXT is ordered and contains only work with a concrete player outcome and acceptance contract.
FUTURE preserves sequenced product families without pretending they are active.
PARKED contains separated or dependency-blocked work and states the release condition.
DONE requires merged or otherwise immutable proof, not a planning claim.
The board does not create sub-beads, meta-audits, or a replacement House hierarchy.
